Based on SparkFun VL53L5CX Arduino Library 1.0.3, commit
424e753a865f004e02c0a37678b9fe252ba6ab5c.
https://github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun_VL53L5CX_Arduino_Library

Local changes: checked byte counts and sticky first transport error, yielding
chunk transfers, transport-error propagation, persistent driver storage, corrected
identity/address handling, and bounded polling that exits on transport failure.
Original source license notices and LICENSE.md are retained.
